entities.summary: Marko Paasikoski (b. 1978-06-10, Kemi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kemi and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
